text:
Priya (oncall): :rotating_light: Noticing elevated 5xx and GPU OOMs in eu-central pool-3 since 01:12 UTC. Error rate ~30% for generation requests. GSLB health checks flipping nodes unhealthy. Can someone take a look?
Jake (infra): On it. autoscaler shows pool-3 at 98% memory and ptrace OOM events. Looks like a noisy workload from a batch job slipped into serving lane.
Lucas (sre): Do we have an immediate routing plan? We should avoid flapping; prefer gradual fanout to eu-west and na-east. Also need to respect data residency tags for EU-only customers.
Maya (ops): If we shift naively we'll violate eu-only routing for some customers. We can set a weight override for non-EU-tagged routes first.
Priya (oncall): Agreed. Proposal: mark pool-3 draining for new sessions, then apply GSLB weight override: move 30% -> eu-west, 20% -> na-east, keep 50% local with soft connections for EU-only.
Jake (infra): I can push weight override. Command I'll run:
```
curl -X POST "https://gslb.internal/api/v1/overrides" \
 -H "Authorization: Bearer $GSLB_KEY" \
 -d '{"region":"eu-central","weight":0.5}' \
 -d '{"region":"eu-west","weight":0.3}' \
 -d '{"region":"na-east","weight":0.2}'
```
Maya (ops): Also enable session-affinity sticky mode for eu-only customer tag to keep compliance while we shift others.
Anita (security): Confirming sticky sessions are fine for short window, ensure logs are captured and PII routing rules not bypassed.
deploy-bot: override accepted, applying new weights (request id gslb-202603-1793). Changes expected to propagate in ~45s.
ops-bot: health-checks: eu-central pool-3 drained=false -> true; new_conn_reject=enabled; 3 nodes marked draining.
Lucas (sre): Observing initial drop in 5xx at edge, tail latency up slightly in eu-west as caches warm. Keep an eye on prefix cache misses.
Priya (oncall): Noted. Running cache pre-warm for common prompts to eu-west:
```
./cli prewarm --region eu-west --prompts-file top_prompts.txt
```
Jake (infra): Also found offending batch job ID batch-4578 scheduled in eu-central; killing it now and revoking access to serve lane.
Maya (ops): Killing job done. Memory pressure dropping on pool-3, node OOMs reduced.
Anita (security): Any risk of log exposure during prewarm? Confirm logs sent to EU-only SIEM.
Priya (oncall): Logs are still bound to eu-sink; confirmed. No cross-region shipping.
Lucas (sre): After 6m: 5xx back down to <2%, tail latency normalized to pre-incident for eu-central. Suggest gradually restoring weights over 10m and leave a 10% buffer.
Jake (infra): Starting weight ramp back: eu-central -> 0.7, eu-west -> 0.2, na-east -> 0.1
deploy-bot: override update accepted (gslb-202603-1793-update). Propagation ~35s.
Maya (ops): Removing draining flag from nodes now.
ops-bot: pool-3 draining=false; all nodes healthy.
Priya (oncall): Monitoring for 15m. Putting a post-incident follow-up task: tighten batch job admission checks and add memguard for gpu pools.
Anita (security): Add compliance check to routing overrides: require explicit tag for cross-border shifts.
Lucas (sre): Filed incident ticket INF-2026-114 with timeline and mitigation steps.
Priya (oncall): Great work team :thumbsup: — closing thread when post-mortem is attached and weights stable for 15m.
Jake (infra): Note cost impact: brief spike in cross-region egress to na-east ~0.4% of daily spend. Will include in postmortem.
Maya (ops): Affirm. No customer-facing downtime reported. Marking mitigated.
Priya (oncall): last check: all metrics green, leaving monitoring runbook in place. :white_check_mark:
